# Data Sources

## Inventory of US City and County Minimum Wage Ordinances - UC Berkeley Labor Center 

The UC Berkeley Labor Center published the *Inventory of US City and County Minimum Wage Ordinances* report on July 23, 2026. This report lists only California localities (cities and counties) whose minimum wages were set by local ordinances, not by state law. I will use this data set in showing the true minimum wage rates for these cities/counties, divided into their respective Metropolitan Statistical Areas (MSAs), for the 2026 fiscal year.

## Consumer Price Index - U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics 

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics published various Consumer Price Index reports for heavily populated Western Metropolitan Statistical Areas (MSAs). This includes reports for the areas of:

1.  San Francisco-Oakland-Hayward,

2.  Los Angeles-Long Beach-Anaheim, and

3.  San Diego-Carlsbad.

I will be using these reports to analyze the CPI-U fluctuations of their respective MSA and adjust their inflation rates as a group, rather than individual cities, from a baseline minimum wage.
